description: Lunar Silk Road is a free mission trainer where students keep a crew of four alive on the Moon or Mars, balancing power, life support, food and radiation shielding in a live 3D base. At its heart is silk: mulberry, silkworms, silk and protein in a closed loop taken from real life-support research. We love space science, education and the idea that one of humanity's oldest materials could help us live beyond Earth. Challenge: Build a Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer.
